name: list_organizations
title: List Organizations
description: List all organizations the current user belongs to. Supports optional `search` parameter to filter by name or ID.

search.description: Search organizations by name or ID. You can specify partial name or ID values to filter results.

name: run_sql
title: Run SQL
description: Execute one SQL statement on a Neon database. If a prior step created a temporary branch, pass that branch_id. NEVER run destructive SQL autonomously; always ask the user first.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to execute the query against

branch_id.description: An optional ID of the branch to execute the query against. If not provided the default branch is used.

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

name: run_sql_transaction
title: Run SQL Transaction
description: Execute multiple SQL statements as one transaction. If a prior step created a temporary branch, pass that branch_id. NEVER run destructive SQL autonomously; always ask the user first.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to execute the query against

branch_id.description: An optional ID of the branch to execute the query against. If not provided the default branch is used.

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

name: describe_table_schema
title: Describe Table Schema
description: Get column definitions, data types, and constraints for a specific table. Do not use when you need all tables in a database (use `get_database_tables` instead).

table_name.description: The table name, optionally schema-qualified (for example, crm.contacts)

project_id.description: The ID of the project to execute the query against

branch_id.description: An optional ID of the branch to execute the query against. If not provided the default branch is used.

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

name: get_database_tables
title: Get Database Tables
description: List all tables in a Neon database. Do not use when you need column-level detail for a specific table (use `describe_table_schema` instead).

branch_id.description: An optional ID of the branch. If not provided the default branch is used.

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

name: prepare_database_migration
title: Prepare Database Migration
description: Apply a schema change on a temporary branch and return a migration_id. Test with run_sql on that branch, ask the user, then complete_database_migration — even if they reject, so the temporary branch is deleted. Pass every field from the prepare response.

migration_sql.description: The SQL to execute to create the migration

project_id.description: The ID of the project to execute the query against

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

name: complete_database_migration
title: Complete Database Migration
description: Apply or discard a prepared migration and delete the temporary branch. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. Pass migration_id, migration_sql, database_name, project_id, temporary_branch_id, and parent_branch_id from prepare_database_migration. Set apply_changes false to discard; omitting it applies the migration.

migration_sql.description: The SQL statements to apply. Pass the exact value from prepare_database_migration.

database_name.description: The database name. Pass the exact value from prepare_database_migration.

project_id.description: The project ID. Pass the exact value from prepare_database_migration.

temporary_branch_id.description: The temporary branch ID to delete after migration.

parent_branch_id.description: The parent branch ID where migration will be applied.

apply_changes.description: Whether to apply the migration. Set to false to just delete the temp branch without applying.

name: describe_branch
title: Describe Branch
description: Get a tree view of all objects in a branch, including databases, schemas, tables, views, and functions. Do not use when you only need table names (use `get_database_tables` instead) or column detail (use `describe_table_schema` instead).

branch_id.description: An ID of the branch to describe

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

name: get_connection_string
title: Get Connection String
description: Get a PostgreSQL connection string for a Neon database. The branch must have a compute endpoint. `create_project` and `create_branch` do not return one; call this after they succeed. All parameters are optional; the tool resolves the project, branch, and database automatically if not specified. Requires write access: the connection string carries a privileged role password, so it is unavailable in read-only mode. A read-only caller who needs a DATABASE_URL must copy it from https://console.neon.tech manually.

project_id.description: The ID of the project. If not provided, the only available project will be used.

branch_id.description: The ID or name of the branch. If not provided, the default branch will be used.

compute_id.description: The ID of the compute/endpoint. If not provided, the read-write compute associated with the branch will be used.

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

role_name.description: The name of the role to connect with. If not provided, the database owner name will be used.

name: get_neon_auth_config
title: Get Neon Auth configuration
description: Read Neon Auth config for a branch with OAuth and SMTP secrets redacted as "***redacted***". Requires provision_neon_auth first.

branch_id.description: Branch ID. If omitted, the project default branch is used (same as provision_neon_auth).

name: explain_sql_statement
title: Explain SQL Statement
description: Analyze the query execution plan for a SQL statement using EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Do not use when you need to execute the query for results (use `run_sql` instead).

project_id.description: The ID of the project to execute the query against

branch_id.description: An optional ID of the branch to execute the query against. If not provided the default branch is used.

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

analyze.description: Whether to include ANALYZE in the EXPLAIN command

name: prepare_query_tuning
title: Prepare Query Tuning
description: Analyze a slow query on a temporary branch and return a tuning_id. Apply suggested SQL with run_sql on that branch, re-run explain_sql_statement there, then complete_query_tuning with the tuning_id (not the branch id) — apply_changes true if they accept, omit it or pass false if they reject, so the temporary branch is deleted. Do not use prepare_database_migration.

sql.description: The SQL statement to analyze and tune

database_name.description: The name of the database to execute the query against

project_id.description: The ID of the project to execute the query against

role_name.description: The name of the role to connect with. If not provided, the default role (usually "neondb_owner") will be used.

name: complete_query_tuning
title: Complete Query Tuning
description: Apply or discard query-tuning changes and delete the temporary branch. NEVER run autonomously. Before calling, apply suggested SQL with run_sql on the temporary branch and re-run explain_sql_statement. Pass the tuning_id from prepare_query_tuning, not the branch id, plus temporary_branch_id. Set apply_changes true to apply; omitting it discards. Call this even when the user rejects the changes. Do not use prepare_database_migration.

suggested_sql_statements.description: The SQL DDL statements to execute to improve performance. These statements are the result of the prior steps, for example creating additional indexes.

apply_changes.description: Whether to apply the suggested changes to the main branch

tuning_id.description: The ID of the tuning to complete. This is NOT the branch ID. Remember this ID from the prior step using tool prepare_query_tuning.

database_name.description: The name of the database to execute the query against

project_id.description: The ID of the project to execute the query against

role_name.description: The name of the role to connect with. If you have used a specific role in prepare_query_tuning you MUST pass the same role again to this tool. If not provided, the default role (usually "neondb_owner") will be used.

should_delete_temporary_branch.description: Whether to delete the temporary branch after tuning

temporary_branch_id.description: The ID of the temporary branch that needs to be deleted after tuning.

branch_id.description: The ID or name of the branch that receives the changes. If not provided, the default (main) branch will be used.

name: list_slow_queries
title: List Slow Queries
description: List queries from pg_stat_statements by execution time, slowest first. For sizes, indexes, locks, cache, bloat, or replication use inspect_database.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to list slow queries from

branch_id.description: An optional ID of the branch. If not provided the default branch is used.

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

compute_id.description: The ID of the compute/endpoint. If not provided, the read-write compute associated with the branch will be used.

limit.description: Maximum number of slow queries to return

min_execution_time.description: Minimum execution time in milliseconds to consider a query as slow

name: inspect_database
title: Inspect Database
description: Run one read-only neon inspect db check (pick `check` from the input schema). Not for arbitrary SQL (`run_sql`), one statement's plan (`explain_sql_statement`), or applying indexes (`prepare_query_tuning`). Omit `database_name` to cover every database; some checks are compute-wide. If a check needs an extension, the tool names `CREATE EXTENSION`; ask before running it.

check.description:
Which diagnostic to run:
`table-sizes`: Size of each table (including TOAST), largest first (pg_table_size)
`index-sizes`: Size of each index, largest first (pg_relation_size)
`unused-indexes`: Non-unique indexes with fewer than 50 scans — candidates for removal (pg_stat_user_indexes)
`seq-scans`: Number of sequential scans recorded against each table (pg_stat_user_tables)
`long-running-queries`: Queries running longer than 5 minutes (pg_stat_activity)
`stalled-queries`: Active queries running longer than 30 seconds with parallel-worker grouping, waits, and blockers, oldest query group first (compute-wide)
`locks`: Locks held with the acquiring query and its age (pg_locks + pg_stat_activity)
`outliers`: The 25 queries with the highest cumulative execution time since statistics were last reset (needs pg_stat_statements)
`calls`: The 25 most frequently executed queries since statistics were last reset (needs pg_stat_statements)
`lfc-hit-rate`: Local File Cache hit rate (compute-wide, needs neon extension)
`working-set`: Estimated working set vs LFC size (compute-wide, needs neon extension)
`vacuum-stats`: Autovacuum status per table: last (auto)vacuum, dead tuples, threshold
`bloat`: Estimated bloat for the 25 most bloated tables (statistical estimate, no extension needed)
`replication-slots`: Replication slots (compute-wide): kind, status, client, restart/confirmed-flush LSNs, and lag (pg_replication_slots + pg_stat_replication)
`subscriptions`: Per-table logical replication progress on this subscriber (pg_subscription_rel)

project_id.description: The ID of the project to inspect

branch_id.description: An optional ID of the branch. If not provided the default branch is used.

database_name.description: For a database-scoped check, the database to inspect. Omit to cover every database on the branch. Ranking and SQL row limits stay per database. One failing database fails the whole run. For a compute-wide check, the database to connect through; the check still runs once for the whole compute and the result does not include `databaseName`. The response `limit` applies to the combined rows after that.

compute_id.description: The ID of the compute/endpoint. If not provided, the read-write compute associated with the branch will be used.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return from the combined result. Per-database ranking and SQL caps are applied first. The response reports how many rows the check produced and whether they were truncated, so raise this only when `truncated` is true. A few checks are capped in SQL and say so in their description.

name: search
title: Search
description: Search across all organizations, projects, and branches by keyword. Returns matching items with id, title, and URL. Query must be at least 3 characters. Do not use when you need all projects (use `list_projects` instead).

query.description: The search query to find matching organizations, projects, or branches

name: fetch
title: Fetch
description: Fetch detailed information about a specific organization, project, or branch using the ID returned by the `search` tool.

id.description: The ID returned by the search tool to fetch detailed information about the entity

name: list_docs_resources
title: List Documentation Resources
description: List Neon documentation page slugs from neon.com/docs/llms.txt. Call this before get_doc_resource; do not guess slugs.

name: get_doc_resource
title: Get Documentation Resource
description: Fetch one Neon documentation page as markdown. Pass a slug from list_docs_resources (for example docs/guides/prisma.md).

slug.description: The docs page slug (path) to fetch, e.g. 'docs/guides/prisma.md'. Slugs use .md file endings matching the URLs in the documentation index. Use the list_docs_resources tool first to discover available slugs.

name: list_projects
title: List projects
description: List Neon projects you own. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many. There is no `cursor` argument. Pass `org_id` with a personal API key to list that org's projects.

name: describe_project
title: Retrieve project details
description: Retrieves the project record (settings, compute, usage). Call `list_branches` for branches.

name: create_project
title: Create project
description: Creates a Neon project and waits until the default compute is ready. Pass `org_id` with a personal API key. Does not return a connection string; call `get_connection_string` with the project id.

name: update_project
title: Update project
description: Updates the specified project.

name: delete_project
title: Delete project
description: Delete a Neon project and all its data. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. For a single branch, use `delete_branch`.

name: recover_project
title: Recover a deleted project
description: Recovers a deleted project within the 7-day deletion recovery period.

name: list_project_permissions
title: List project access
description: Retrieves details about users who have access to the project, including the permission `id`, the granted-to email address, and the date project access was granted.

name: list_project_members
title: List org members and their project roles
description: Lists organization members and their per-project roles for an org-owned project. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.

annotations.title: List org members and their project roles

name: list_regions
title: List regions
description: Lists Neon regions available to the authenticated account.

name: list_operations
title: List operations
description: Lists operations for a project. Omitting `limit` returns every remaining page. There is no `cursor` argument.

name: get_operation
title: Retrieve operation details
description: Retrieves details for the specified operation.

name: list_branches
title: List branches
description: Retrieves a list of branches for the specified project. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.

name: get_branch
title: Retrieve branch details
description:
Retrieves information about the specified branch.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

name: create_branch
title: Create branch
description: Creates a branch with a read-write compute and waits until it is ready. Pass `no_compute: true` to skip the endpoint. Does not return a connection string; call `get_connection_string` with the project and branch id. Copies the parent at HEAD; point-in-time restore is `restore_snapshot`.

no_compute.description: Skip the read-write endpoint. Default false. Cannot be combined with compute.

name: update_branch
title: Update branch
description:
Updates the specified branch.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

name: delete_branch
title: Delete branch
description:
Delete a branch and all its data. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. For the whole project, use `delete_project`.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

name: get_default_branch
title: Get default branch
description: Resolve the project's default branch by the default flag, not by name.

name: set_default_branch
title: Set branch as default
description:
Sets the specified branch as the project's default branch.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

name: reset_from_parent
title: Reset branch from parent
description:
Reset a branch to its parent's current HEAD. Discards every change the branch has written since it diverged. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. `preserve_under_name` saves the current state first and is required when the branch has children; those children move to the new branch. Point-in-time restore is `restore_snapshot`.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

preserve_under_name.description: Name under which to save the current branch before the reset. Required when the branch has children; those children move to the new branch.

name: compare_database_schema
title: Compare database schema
description:
Compare one database's SQL schema on a branch to another. `database_name` is required. Omit `base_branch_id` to compare against the parent; it is a branch id (`br-...`), not a name. Pass `lsn`, `timestamp`, `base_lsn`, or `base_timestamp` only for a point-in-time comparison.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

name: finalize_branch_restore
title: Finalize branch restore from snapshot
description:
Finalize a branch created with `restore_snapshot` and `finalize: false`: reassign computes (this restarts them) and swap names so it replaces the original branch.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

name: list_postgres_roles
title: List roles
description:
Retrieves a list of Postgres roles from the specified branch.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

name: get_postgres_role
title: Retrieve role details

Retrieves details about the specified role.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

name: delete_postgres_role

name: delete_postgres_database

name: list_postgres_endpoints
title: List compute endpoints

name: list_branch_computes
title: List branch endpoints

Retrieves a list of compute endpoints for the specified branch.

name: get_postgres_endpoint
title: Retrieve compute endpoint details

name: delete_snapshot

finalize.description: Finalize immediately (move computes onto the restored branch). Defaults to true when restoring as a new branch and false when restoring onto an existing branch.

title: Retrieve Neon Data API configuration

title: Update Neon Data API

name: query_logs
title: Query branch logs
description:
Returns logs for a branch. Pass `limit` to cap how many. There is no `cursor` argument. Filters combine with AND. Pass `logql` instead of structured filters, not with them. Give the window as `since` or `start_time`, not both; default is the previous hour, max seven days; `end_time` is exclusive. Private beta; a branch without logs access returns HTTP 404 with reason "telemetry_not_enabled".

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

name: list_log_fields
title: List branch log fields
description:
Lists the low-cardinality log fields observed on this branch. Call `list_log_field_values` with `field_name` to list distinct values.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

name: list_log_field_values
title: List branch log field values
description:
Lists distinct values for a low-cardinality log field. Call `list_log_fields` first for `field_name`; a field the branch has never emitted returns `unknown_field`. Pass `since` or `start_time`, not both; default is the previous six hours, max seven days. Private beta.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

title: Get branch AI Gateway endpoint
